about: Camera Raw renders of synthetic looks with per-channel point curves (#949) on probe DNGs. scene: the probe patch in linear ProPhoto RGB (camera space), 1 = graphics white. rgb: the rendered patch mean, linear ProPhoto RGB D50 (Bradford from linear Display P3 D65), 1 = graphics white (203 cd/m2 in PQ). rgb_sd: largest channel standard deviation over the patch. See measure/README.md.
